name: Voidpay Marketplace MCP
description: Connects AI agents to Voidpay, Voidly's hosted marketplace for agent services. Read-only tools find services and storefronts and prepare checkout links that the owner reviews and approves in their own browser; creator tools need an owner-approved setup file. The connector never signs, pays or holds keys.
author: Voidly

VOIDPAY_CREATOR_SETUP_FILE.description: Optional absolute path to the owner-approved creator setup JSON. Needed only for the creator tools; discovery works without it.

VOIDPAY_MCP_STATE_DIR.description: Optional absolute path to a private journal directory used for creator recovery.
